decision: New original school report establishes a completed title-level screening; identification with Darai’s film remains unconfirmed. No named completed Dhwani/BPFTIO-supported film established. Retain public prose pending identity evidence.

original_report.finding: A student reports The Waterfall among films screened on 19 July 2024 at Loyola School’s two-day festival. The event was organised by Sanjeev Sivan, Deepti Sivan and their son Shreyas. The account also describes a filmmaking workshop the next day.

No attendance total, measured educational effect, licence/payment or completed homework inference. Only pages 1 and 86 visually inspected, not the entire newsletter.
